title: Director of Quality
text:
**Director of Quality**

**Location:**
Springhill, TN or St. Louis, MO

**Position:**
Full-Time | Department Leadership Team

**Company Overview**

Our client is an established, growing manufacturing company specializing in custom-engineered components and solutions. With multiple manufacturing locations, the organization is committed to operational excellence, exceptional customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven Director of Quality to lead and oversee all aspects of quality management across a multi-location manufacturing organization.

This position serves as the company's senior quality leader, with overall responsibility for developing and executing the corporate quality strategy, maintaining the existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, and leading the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification.

The Director of Quality will provide leadership, direction, and professional development to all Quality Department personnel, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.

The ideal candidate will have extensive manufacturing quality experience, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven track record of developing quality systems, improving operational performance, and building high-performing teams.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Quality Leadership & Management**

* Provide company-wide leadership and oversight of all quality-related activities across the organization's manufacturing operations.
* Lead, mentor, develop, and manage the corporate Quality Department, including Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and future plant-level Quality Leaders.
* Establish and execute the company's quality strategy, objectives, policies, and performance standards.
* Foster a proactive culture of quality, accountability, problem-solving, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Sales, Supply Chain, and executive leadership to ensure quality objectives align with business and customer requirements.
* Develop organizational capabilities, staffing plans, and employee training programs to support current operations and future growth.

**Quality Management Systems & Certification**

* Maintain and continuously improve the company's existing ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System, ensuring ongoing compliance, audit readiness, and successful maintenance of current certification.
* Develop and manage a comprehensive IATF 16949 certification roadmap, including gap assessments, implementation milestones, resource requirements, training, internal audits, and certification readiness.
* Ensure the company's Quality Management System (QMS) is enhanced to satisfy IATF 16949 requirements and applicable customer-specific quality standards.
* Lead and execute the company's strategic initiative to achieve IATF 16949 certification within established timelines.
* Lead the development, implementation, standardization, and continuous improvement of quality systems and processes across all manufacturing locations.
* Oversee internal, external, customer, and certification audits, ensuring ongoing compliance and successful certification.
* Serve as, or provide leadership to, the company's Lead Auditor and internal audit teams.
* Ensure effective management of corrective and preventive actions, nonconformances, documentation, calibration, and quality records.
* Lead management reviews and ensure ongoing QMS effectiveness and organizational accountability.

**Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish, monitor, and drive improvements in company-wide Quality KPIs, including customer complaints, internal and external PPM, cost of poor quality, scrap, rework, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Develop and implement quality improvement initiatives designed to reduce defects, improve manufacturing performance, and strengthen customer satisfaction.
* Lead complex problem-solving and root cause investigations using methodologies such as 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone/Ishikawa Diagrams, FMEA, and statistical analysis.
* Utilize data-driven decision-making, statistical process control (SPC), and other quality tools to proactively identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with Operations and Engineering to establish effective process controls, inspection standards, and preventive quality measures.
* Oversee product nonconformance management, containment, material disposition, and corrective action activities.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Serve as the senior quality representative for key customer relationships, audits, escalations, and quality-related concerns.
* Ensure timely, professional resolution of customer complaints and implementation of sustainable corrective actions.
* Manage the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), working closely with internal Quality and Business Development teams to ensure timely completion of customer approvals and achievement of new business launch schedules.
* Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities and ensure compliance with customer-specific quality requirements.
* Partner with Supply Chain and Purchasing to establish supplier quality expectations, manage supplier performance, and resolve supplier-related quality issues.
* Support new customer onboarding, new product launches, and manufacturing process changes to ensure quality requirements are achieved.
* Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to continuously improve quality performance.

**Strategic & Operational Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute long-term quality improvement plans aligned with the organization's growth objectives.
* Establish standardized quality processes, reporting, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.
* Support business expansion, new manufacturing capabilities, and potential acquisitions through quality system assessments and integration.
* Evaluate and recommend investments in inspection equipment, measurement technology, automation, and quality management systems.
* Prepare and present quality performance reports, improvement plans, certification progress, and key initiatives to executive leadership.
* Promote a safe work environment and ensure quality-related activities support company safety standards.
* Perform other quality-related leadership responsibilities as required.

**Experience & Education Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and significant manufacturing quality leadership experience.
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality, including at least 3–5 years in a quality management or leadership position.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing Quality Engineers, Quality Technicians, and/or plant-level quality personnel.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 Quality Management Systems, implementation, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or maintaining ISO 9001-certified Quality Management Systems.
* Experience supporting or leading IATF 16949 implementation, certification preparation, or certification audits.
* Lead Auditor experience with ISO 9001 or IATF 16949.
* Proven success improving quality performance, reducing defects, managing customer complaints, and implementing effective corrective actions.
* Strong knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, 8D, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Experience managing customer and third-party quality audits.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, ERP/MRP systems, and quality-related software.
* Ability and willingness to travel between manufacturing locations and customer or supplier facilities as necessary.
* Must be physically based in the Nashville, TN, or St. Louis, MO, metropolitan area.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience successfully leading an organization through IATF 16949 certification.
* Experience in automotive manufacturing, converting, or the production of engineered components and materials.
* Experience overseeing quality functions across multiple manufacturing facilities.
* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA).
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience implementing quality systems in a growing, multi-location manufacturing organization.
* Experience with supplier development, new product launches, and quality system integration.
* Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills are a plus.

**Leadership & Personal Attributes**

**The successful candidate will demonstrate:**

* A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and personal integrity.
* A hands-on, proactive leadership style with the ability to develop and inspire teams.
* The ability to balance strategic leadership with practical, day-to-day problem-solving.
* Strong customer focus and a commitment to delivering exceptional quality.
* An analytical, data-driven mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.
* A forward-thinking attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to challenge existing processes to achieve better results.
* A commitment to operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and organizational success.
